Select exact IC50 activity rows for CHEMBL1865. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Filter by assay CHEMBL1865, standard_type IC50, and pubmed_id IS NOT NULL. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all rows; do not deduplicate.
